searchText: Here is an update of a naive interop! https://x.com/jih2nn/status/1882004899782902145 Also, a PR to Prysm is opened, please take a look when you have some time cc <@363800010518822915> https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/14819 Besides the PR, one thing I want to mention is Prysm's .runLateBlockTasks seems to be flaky even when `seconds_per_slot` is 6 seconds. This makes test iteration longer as Fulu fork turns on from epoch 2, which is equivalent to 6.4 minutes. Any idea on this? Nice fix. I hope you dont mind I just squash the PR into mine <@845691100072509460> could you write down what is tested so far? Example the methods and the cases. i'll think about more cases today In particular do we know if this is true: - If there's a transaction in the the IL as I retrieve it via GetInclusionList, could the transaction be in the GetPayload or not? Not at all, having one commit makes git history cleaner. I think it would be great if we could have a sort of test spec. This is what we lack of at the moment, if I'm not wrong, and it would be great help for other client teams to catch up. I'm thinking about using assertoor. Once we list up test cases, let me try out assertoor. I think yes and no. If the IL transaction is propagated to a builder and the builder includes it in the payload, it's yes. No otherwise. <@363800010518822915> from your notes > Get: Returns all inclusion list transactions for a slot, excluding duplicates. How do you deduplicate those? transactions are just opaque bytes for us on the CL side. Just byte comparsion? Correct! Oh I was just asking in your geth implemention, do you remove the txs after get payload call? Or do you reuse them for get inclusion lists as well I've written down the meta test cases here: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/focil-interop-test-cases Anything missing?
